        <div id="cc-matrix-1815368913"><div id="cc-m-7203069013" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7203069013">KITE TRIP TO EL GOUNA</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7203069113" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-7203069113">Egypt: 11.–18.04.2026</h2></div><div id="cc-m-7203069213" class="j-module n j-text "><p class="MsoNormal">
    Another unforgettable week in El Gouna! This incredible group of women brought together different kite levels and one shared passion - a combination that never gets old. El Gouna delivered once
    again with great wind conditions and a wonderful time on and off the water.
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">
     
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">
    And on the quieter wind days? We simply made the most of it - good company, good vibes, and a proper holiday. Because that's what it's really about.
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">
     
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">
    Watching our girls progress and, above all, have an absolute blast was everything. We loved every minute of it and we can't wait to do it all again next year. 
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7203069313" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">
    
</div>
